episode_notes: A Telugu bachelor comedy following Karthik (an aspiring TV serial actor) and Arjun (a working professional) living in a penthouse flat. Their mutual friend sneaks his runaway girlfriend Deepika into their apartment to hide her for three days, putting them in danger of eviction by their eccentric landlord Bhishma who fanatically hates women and enforces strict anti-women tenancy rules.

episode_summary.episode_notes: A Telugu bachelor comedy following Karthik (an aspiring TV serial actor) and Arjun (a working professional) living in a penthouse flat. Their mutual friend sneaks his runaway girlfriend Deepika into their apartment to hide her for three days, putting them in danger of eviction by their eccentric landlord Bhishma who fanatically hates women and enforces strict anti-women tenancy rules.

moment_table.why: After a TV daily serial endlessly stretches the tension of a big reveal only to cut straight to a commercial, Karthik vents every viewer's frustration with 'థూ ఇంకెన్ని రోజుల్రా ఇలా సాగతీస్తారు?'.
After figning deep offense at Arjun's background questions and guilt-tripping him into a panic, Karthik breaks character laughing with 'నమ్మేసినావా బాగా act చేసిన కదా' to prove his acting chops.

moment_table.text: దిగిన వెంటనే తన కాళ్ళ మీద తను నిలబడడానికి తన కాళ్ళు ఇంకా ready గా లేవని గ్రహించిందన్నమాట.
moment_table.why: After hyping up Deepika's dramatic walkout to stand on her own feet, the friend hilariously undercuts it by confessing 'తన కాళ్ళ మీద తను నిలబడడానికి తన కాళ్ళు ఇంకా ready గా లేవని గ్రహించిందన్నమాట'.

moment_table.text: అందులో Siri అనే అమ్మాయి వస్ వచ్చేసరికి phone నాలుగేసి కొట్టేసి మళ్ళీ Nokia 3310 వాడుతున్నాడు.
moment_table.why: While recounting their landlord Bhishma's bizarre misogyny, Arjun delivers the peak punchline revealing he smashed his new iPhone because 'Siri అనే అమ్మాయి voice వచ్చేసరికి' and went back to Nokia 3310.
When the boys ask if they can provide their mother's phone number on the lease since their father passed away, landlord Bhishma asks if she is a woman and deadpans 'అయితే వద్దు'.
